annotations.title: Take the next document to read

description: Take the next document of the project's reading. Returns `task` and `token` (needed for every call about this document), the `instructions` and the `checklist` of questions (Q1..Qn), and the first `page` of its `sections` (numbered; `pages` says how many pages there are, fetch the others with geothought_document_sections). Read each section and answer only from it, with verbatim quotes; send your replies with geothought_submit_replies. The document is yours for an hour after each call about it. Returns document: null when none is waiting.
name: geothought_next_document
title: Take the next document to read
